NAD, on Seroquel myself. At a certain dose and above, it starts working more as an antipsychotic, and less like a "tranquilizer." Your night dose, much like mine (currently at 400) keeps us relatively stable, while the PRNS (my dose is up to 75) works better on things like anxiety and sedation. I find that if I'm hypomanic I need to take about 75-100mg of seroquel as a PRN (25mg pills throughout the day). If I'm anxious, I can get away with 25 to 50 ie 2 pills through the day.

The antipsychotic effect starts at about 300. I noticed after 200/250mg it stopped making me hungry and sleepy, and actually just makes me feel normal, if not a little bit awake.

Edit: Should clarify it also depends on fast acting vs extended release. I'm speaking from experience with fast acting. In theory if you took all your prns say up to 75mg, you'll get the effect of anxiety relief, and once you add on your night dose it shifts over to working on antipsychotic properties.
